applied_mappings.review_note: The source and target use byte-identical DS4 composite model artifacts and the same pinned DS4 binary, branch, 131072-token allocation, hybrid KV, prefill chunk, resident-base and demand-paged PLE policy, eviction interval, prefix reuse setting, MTP-disabled setting, and output ceiling. Only the measurement harness differs. The projected swap result describes the repeated 126K retrieval position and is not generalized to a longer multi-turn session.

The source and target use byte-identical DS4 composite artifacts and the same pinned DS4 binary and complete inference configuration. Only the harness and prompt position differ. This projected 3/3 result is a minimum exact synthetic tool-emission gate and does not replace the Harbor verifier-scored quality axis.
